title: Satellite-derived bathymetry of Arabian Gulf ports under leakage-free validation: a multi-site benchmark of empirical, machine-learning and deep-learning models against 285,000 multibeam soundings, with an outlook for UAE waters
abstract: arXiv:2610.33609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Satellite-derived bathymetry (SDB) is often proposed as a low-cost complement to multibeam surveys of ports, but its accuracy is seldom measured on an area the model has never seen. We test SDB in the turbid, shallow and tidal waters of the Abu Dhabi coast against 285,619 multibeam soundings from twelve surveys at six port areas, reduced to Lowest Astronomical Tide. The Stumpf ratio, the Lyzenga transform, a monotonic gradient-boosted tree model (LightGBM) and a U-Net ensemble were trained on 72 Sentinel-2 images and tested in transfer to an unseen site and with local control (about 20% of a site's soundings, spatial blocks beyond a 225 m buffer). The validation design changed the result more than the model: the same LightGBM model gave 0.57 m RMSE under a random pixel split, 1.30 m under spatial blocks and 1.66 m at an unseen site. In transfer the Stumpf ratio (1.45 m) was not beaten by LightGBM, the U-Net or Lyzenga. With local control

translated_title: 无泄漏验证下阿拉伯湾港口的卫星反演水深：基于285,000个多波束测深数据的经验模型、机器学习与深度学习模型多站点基准测试，兼论阿联酋海域的应用前景
translated_abstract: 卫星反演水深（SDB）常被提出作为港口多波束测量的低成本补充手段，但其精度很少在模型从未见过的区域上进行评估。我们在阿布扎比海岸浑浊、浅水且受潮汐影响的水域，利用来自六个港口区域十二次测量的285,619个多波束测深点（已归算至最低天文潮位）对SDB进行了测试。Stumpf比值法、Lyzenga变换、单调梯度提升树模型以及U-Net集成模型在72幅Sentinel-2图像上训练，并在两种条件下进行测试：迁移到从未见过的站点，以及局部控制（使用约20%的站点测深数据，且空间块位于225米缓冲区之外）。验证设计对结果的影响比模型选择更大：同一个LightGBM模型在随机像素分割下的均方根误差（RMSE）为0.57米，在空间块分割下为1.30米，在未见站点上为1.66米。在迁移测试中，Stumpf比值法（1.45米）的表现未被LightGBM、U-Net或Lyzenga超越。在局部控制条件下……
tldr: 该研究在阿联酋六个港口对卫星反演水深进行无泄漏验证的多站点基准测试，发现验证方案设计对精度评估的影响远大于模型选择，且简单的Stumpf比值法在跨站点迁移中表现优于机器学习和深度学习模型。
en_tdlr: This multi-site benchmark of satellite-derived bathymetry at six Arabian Gulf ports under leakage-free validation shows that validation design affects accuracy far more than model choice, with the simple Stumpf ratio outperforming machine-learning and deep-learning models in cross-site transfer.
